ImageDescription.value:
Name: Jerusalem St. George Cathedral
Description: St. George's Cathedral is an Anglican-Episcopal cathedral. The cathedral is located in a large complex established in 1898 and also includes a hostel for pilgrims and a college. It serves as the cathedral of the Episcopal Bishop of Jerusalem, the head of the Episcopal Church in Jerusalem and the Middle East, which unites the faithful of the church in Israel, the Palestinian Authority, Jordan, Syria, and Lebanon.
